material_selection_reason: Review 2 must be fresh relative to the first verifier and the implementing coordinator, confirm the literal two-path source commit provenance, and rerun both focused and registered phase gates under a new synthetic identity. External routes cannot handle the native runtime/environment boundary; SOL provides the decisive no-repair verification.

reviewer-1: Freshness requires a different verifier after the provenance finding.
implementing-coordinator: The implementer owns final acceptance but is not independent.
external-providers: Native registered-ladder execution and environment isolation are not externalized.
native-luna-or-terra: No advantage for the decisive lifecycle/provenance gate.

access_boundary.readable: frozen two-path candidate, repair/failure records, relevant test lifecycle and verify registry
access_boundary.writable: none in tracked repository or Paper; test runtime artifacts only
access_boundary.forbidden: repair, source/config/doc/state mutation, real environment values, unrelated profiles/tests, and further delegation
